hello.text: Captain Ravel. Riverwatch holds the crossing. What's your business?

choices.text: Could you see to my wounds?

t0.text: The bridge. The road east goes over it, and whoever holds it decides who crosses. We hold it. Barely.

t1.text: Bandits in the autumn wood, bold enough to hit the road in daylight. And lights. In the hills north-west, round the old broken tower. My lads won't patrol there after dark. I don't blame them.
